notes.headline: Three teams stay perfect as the IST field takes shape
notes.dek: Guangdong, LeBrown James and Shanghai all moved to 4–0. Shanghai had the week's best line, and Jakobi, Zhang and Yash clinched their IST groups.
notes.byline: Written from Fantrax league data for Week 4 (Nov 9–15).

storylines.title: Shanghai's statement week
storylines.body: Shanghai would have beaten 10 of 11 teams, leading the league in points (867), threes (120) and steals (60), and edged Team OD 5–4. They join Guangdong and LeBrown James at 4–0.

storylines.title: IST: three groups decided
storylines.body: Jakobi (Competing God) beat Hunter 7–1–1, Zhang (Shanghai) beat Stevie 5–4 and Yash (LeBrown James) beat Ethan 5–4, so all three are 2–0 and through to the semis. Group A comes down to Tom (Bankruptcy) at Zach (Guangdong) this week; both are 1–0.

storylines.title: Blocktopus bounces back
storylines.body: Blocktopus beat Bankruptcy 6–3 with the league's best FG% (.494) and most blocks (47). Wembanyama led the league for a third straight week: 110 points and 42 rebounds on 62% shooting. Blocktopus' week would have beaten 9 teams.

storylines.title: Big men's week
storylines.body: Alperen Sengun (101 points, 44 rebounds) and Karl-Anthony Towns (59 rebounds) joined Wembanyama among the week's best. Darryn Peterson topped the rookies with 92 points, and Trae Young (K-Ville) takes the Brown Shirt at 19 of 55.

storylines.title: Now with betting lines
storylines.body: Every matchup now has a line, and the Standings page tracks each team's record against the spread back to Week 1. Favorites have covered only 5 of 18 decided lines so far; Zach Babies are a perfect 3–0–1 ATS.

matchups.auysoygrmqqv88in_070oazg4mqqv88in: IST Group A decider: Tom (Bankruptcy) at Zach (Guangdong), both 1–0. Projects 7–2 Guangdong; Bankruptcy's edges are FT% and turnovers.
matchups.b33iacngmqqv88in_saydaqzgmqqv88in: Projects 7–2 Blocktopus, with everything but threes and turnovers.
matchups.n3z2eshxmqqv88in_rufupenmmqqv88in: Projects 7–2 Competing God; Zach Babies' edges are FG% and turnovers.
matchups.mizl2op8mqqv88im_d91prsm4mqqv88in: Projects 5–4 Team OD: FG%, threes, rebounds, blocks and turnovers against Presti's FT%, points, assists and steals.
matchups.xoe774vlmqqv88in_ctvglb6gmqqv88in: Projects 5–4 K-Ville, with threes, FT%, assists, steals and turnovers against eweiss35's FG%, points, rebounds and blocks.
matchups.cipchrpimqqv88in_ygisq4rlmqqv88in: Battle of the unbeatens. Projects 5–4 LeBrown James (FG%, FT%, points, assists, blocks) over Shanghai (threes, rebounds, steals, turnovers).

bruno.auysoygrmqqv88in: New No. 1. Cooper Flagg and Darryn Peterson are both 23 in the title season, and Anthony Edwards (29) is still in his prime. Tenth today, but their strength climbs every year.
bruno.d91prsm4mqqv88in: Second. Dylan Harper and Caleb Wilson (both 24 in 2030–31) give them a young base, with Haliburton (30) back from injury. Their line rises steadily.
bruno.070oazg4mqqv88in: Third, and first today. Doncic is 31 in the title season, with Holmgren (28) and Cade Cunningham (29) still in their primes, so the decline is gentle.
bruno.b33iacngmqqv88in: Fourth, and third today. Wembanyama and Duren are both 26 in the title season, with Kessler (29) behind them. No picks, but the line holds steady through 2031.
bruno.ygisq4rlmqqv88in: Fifth on both lists. Maxey (30) and Donovan Clingan (26) are the 2030–31 core, but Tatum is 32 by then, so the line stays flat.
bruno.mizl2op8mqqv88im: Sixth. Shai is 32 and Bam Adebayo 33 in the title season, with Kon Knueppel (25) as the young piece. Fourth today, so the window is now.
bruno.saydaqzgmqqv88in: Seventh, with eight picks, the second-most in the league. AJ Dybantsa (23) and VJ Edgecombe (25) lead a roster whose strength rises every season.
bruno.xoe774vlmqqv88in: Eighth. Second-best roster today, but Jokic is 35 and Murray 33 in the title season, and their strength falls every year.
bruno.rufupenmmqqv88in: Ninth. Cameron Boozer (23) and Morez Johnson (24) are a real young base, but the rest of the core ages out.
bruno.ctvglb6gmqqv88in: Tenth. Kevin Porter (30), Michael Porter (32) and Austin Reaves (32) are past their peaks by 2030–31, and they hold no picks.
bruno.cipchrpimqqv88in: Eleventh. Dyson Daniels and Amen Thompson (both 27) are a good base, but the line drifts down as the veterans age.
bruno.n3z2eshxmqqv88in: Twelfth, but ten picks are the most in the league. Nate Ament (23) is the start; expect a big climb once those picks turn into players.
